source_note: No real-source records are included in the generated starter files. Mixed mode must fetch public records in a network-enabled environment.
limitations: Synthetic template-generated examples are weakly labeled and not representative of natural conversation.
Synthetic rows are not real user messages.
Sensitive categories are not clinical or legal judgments.
Public emotion datasets do not automatically provide annotations for profanity, abuse, sexual boundaries, discrimination, or self-harm.
Human review is recommended before training or evaluation.
